subject: EOQ surge support — accelerated credits & short pilot extension
messages:
From: Sam Cole <sam.cole@velum.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question — pilot runway + production gating

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Hope you’re both well. We’re approaching an internal milestone at Velum where we need to demonstrate production throughput with live traffic by the end of October. The PoC has gone well, but product wants a small top-up of credits and a 2-week trial extension so we can run a full load test and validate the integration before the board review.

Can Redwood do a one-time uplift (usage credit) + a short extension tied to a follow-on committed pilot? If so, what would you need from our side to make this happen this week?

If helpful: expected extra token consumption ~60k tokens over two weeks; likely to convert to a 12-month paid pilot if the load run looks good.

Thanks,
Sam Cole
Director of Platform Engineering
Velum Analytics
sam.cole@velum.ai
+1 415 555 0123
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick question — pilot runway + production gating

Ben / Vanessa — forwarding Sam’s ask. Short version: Velum is asking for a 1-off usage credit (~60k tokens) and a 2-week trial extension. They signal a high chance to convert to a 12-month paid pilot if we can let them run a full load test this month.

Recommended approach:
- Approve a conditional credit of $3,500 (equivalent to suggested token uplift)
- Add a 2-week extension to the trial window tied to a signed follow-on PO or an intent email from procurement by 10/20
- Include a small success metric (throughput >= 120 req/s sustained) in the proposal so marketing can justify the uplift internally

Attachments: draft proposal + pricing annex (I’ll attach). Need Ben’s sign-off on the $3.5k credit and Vanessa to confirm we can attach the short-term SLA for the load window.

Thoughts?

—Markus
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T12:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick question — pilot runway + production gating

Markus — fine to approve the $3.5k one-time credit. Couple of conditions: 1) require procurement intent email/LOI by 10/20, 2) include a 12-month minimum commit language in the pilot terms (discounted ARR if they sign). Vanessa — please confirm SLA attachment.

Ben
Head of Americas Sales
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Cole <sam.cole@velum.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — pilot runway + production gating

Sam — thanks for the context and congrats on the solid PoC results. We can support a short runway bump to help you get the production validation across the finish line. Summary of what we’re offering: 

- One-time usage credit: $3,500 (applied to your trial account) — target uplift ~60k tokens
- Trial extension: +14 days from your current trial expiry
- Conditions: we’ll apply the credit/extension once we receive a procurement intent email or signed LOI by 2026-10-20; we’ll include a 12-month pilot commit term in the follow-on SOW with a conversion discount (details in the attached proposal)

I’ve attached the Redwood Accelerator Proposal and the pricing annex. Also included is a short SLA for the load window so your ops team can rely on predictable latency during the test. If this looks good, please reply with a procurement intent note and I’ll trigger the credit and extension immediately. We can spin a DocuSign for the follow-on pilot SOW after the intent arrives.

DocuSign preview link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/VELOCITY-1098
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/1098

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through the SLA or the test plan.

Regards,
Markus Klein
VP, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0199
